About Our App

The Campus Food Management System (CFMS) is your all-in-one digital companion for campus dining.

Whether you are a student looking to check the daily menu, or a staff member managing complaints, our app bridges the gap between the kitchen and the campus community.

Features: Real-time menu updates, instant complaint tracking, hygiene reporting, and direct communication with food officers.
